rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for emphasizing a broad range of different kinds.

example.english: There are various activities, so let’s take our time choosing.
example.traditional: 各種各樣嘅活動，等我哋慢慢揀啦。
example.jyutping: gok3 zung2 gok3 joeng6 ge3 wut6 dung6 dang2 ngo5 dei6 maan6 maan6 gaan2 laa1

rows.note: Use this in everyday speech when “various” means simply different, especially before 嘅 + noun.

example.english: There are various restaurants here; it depends what you want to eat.
example.traditional: 呢度有唔同嘅餐廳，睇下你想食乜。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 caan1 teng1 tai2 haa5 nei5 soeng2 sik6 mat1
